tasks.goal: Restore an accessible project authorization snapshot when the local project ID is missing.
input_facts: Login currently requests global authorization with no project ID
project-context store already resolves and persists the first accessible project
project workbench requests do not require a project context header
invariants: Global authorization is available before project restoration
Project-context restoration failure does not clear tokens or system menus
No localStorage writes outside the project-context store
interface_contracts: useProjectContextStore.initialize() provides currentId when an accessible project exists
GET /api/auth/routes retains its existing request and response shape
non_goals: No change to the project workbench API
No JWT, HTTP interceptor, backend authorization, or selector behavior change
action_bounds: Initialize project context only after a successful no-project authorization snapshot
Refresh authorization only with the resolved currentId
Treat project restoration as optional and retain the global snapshot on failure
acceptance_checks: A missing ccb.current_project_id restores an accessible project after login or session hydration
Project-level routes are present in the authorization snapshot after restoration
No-project and workbench-failure cases retain global authorization
evidence_required: local runtime or focused request evidence
tasks.rollback: Revert only T4 auth-store restoration helper and its invocation.
stop_conditions: Need to write a project ID directly, change the workbench API, HTTP header, JWT, or server authorization
escalation_conditions: Project-context initialization creates a request loop or global routes render a project selector
